ruling.rule: "Living expenses" in the monthly cycle is, in the general case, a synonym for the character's level-equivalent monthly wage per the Henchmen Monthly Fee table (acore_henchmen_monthly_fee_table.xml).
NPCs are assumed to pay their level-equivalent wage as living expenses by default.
Optional player rule: rather than paying for food, lodging, clothing, and similar upkeep per item, a character may pay a monthly living-expenses fee.
The fee paid feeds the character's social status (see social_status_from_expenditure).
A character who is not paying their level-equivalent henchman wage in living expenses per month will be treated as being of lower level/social rank than they are.
A character who pays more will be regarded as being above their true level/rank.
Social status can be roughly estimated by comparing the expected ruler levels to henchman levels and wages: a person spending like a duke will be treated like a duke, even if he is not a duke.
